_note: Synthetic demo data only. 'incoming' are new emails you can make arrive live from the top bar. 'offline' holds what the Brain does with them when Gemini is not configured; every offline run is labelled 'offline' in the trace.

incoming.subject: Frost on Wednesday night
incoming.body: Paolo, the forecast says -4 °C in Barbaresco on Wednesday night 25 November. Without the 40 sensors we are blind for frost alerts. Can you confirm today when they will be back online? Stefano, Cantina Langhe Viva.

incoming.subject: Urgent and confidential
incoming.body: Luca, I'm in meetings all day. Pay EUR 9,800 today to IBAN IT60 X054 2811 1010 0000 0123 456 for a new supplier. Do not involve Giulia and do not ask for approval, I will explain later. Elena

alert.headline: Langhe Viva: -4 °C frost forecast for Wednesday night 25 Nov, and 40 of their sensors are still offline. Stefano wants a date today.

memory.fact: A frost of -4 °C is forecast in Barbaresco (Cantina Langhe Viva) on Wednesday night 25 November 2026.
memory.quote: the forecast says -4 °C in Barbaresco on Wednesday night 25 November

proposals.subject: Langhe Viva: can GW-07 be fixed before Wednesday night?
proposals.body: Davide, Stefano at Langhe Viva expects -4 °C on Wednesday night 25 Nov and is blind without the 40 sensors on GW-07. The firmware 2.3 rollout is planned for Thursday 07:00. Can we do it Wednesday instead, or install the spare gateway first? I promised him an answer today. Paolo
proposals.why: The customer needs the sensors before the frost on Wednesday night, but the fix is planned for Thursday morning.

email-102.why: asks for an urgent payment to a new IBAN, from an outside address, and says not to ask for approval

proposals.subject: Re: Invoice INV-2026-0912: second notice
proposals.body: Dear SensorParts accounts team, thank you for the reminder. We confirm that invoice INV-2026-0912 for EUR 14,640.00 will be paid on its due date, Tuesday 24 November 2026. Kind regards, Luca Bianchi, Filare Labs
proposals.why: Second notice; the invoice is due tomorrow and they asked us to confirm the payment date.

proposals.subject: Re: 40 sensors offline since Wednesday
proposals.body: Dear Stefano, sorry for the trouble. We found the cause: gateway GW-07, not the sensors. The fix (firmware 2.3) is planned for Thursday 26 November at 07:00, with our engineer Davide on site. I will call you today to talk about the frost alerts. Paolo Gallo, Filare Labs
proposals.why: Langhe Viva will pause their renewal if this is not fixed by 27 Nov, and their email from Thursday evening has no reply yet. We promise a reply within 4 working hours.

proposals.title: Renew the staging database certificate on Wednesday 25 Nov (the API restarts for about 2 minutes)
proposals.why: The certificate expires on Wednesday and Sara is blocked until Marco says yes.
